acceptance_criteria.description: Removing or forging EOL attribution on a uniform Cargo projection fails closed in doctor, repeated init, and remove; mixed sources retain their explicit no-token compatibility only while current content remains mixed.
Created-dependency attribution requires the exact generated marker, one inline dependency declaration, and exactly optional/path/version keys with supported values.
Focused attribution/init/remove/doctor tests, build, and pack check pass.

closed_decisions: The two independent P1 findings are authoritative and must both be closed before certification.
A uniform current Cargo file without exactly one known EOL token is invalid; a mixed current file may omit the token and is never globally normalized.
Created dependency provenance is exact: one generated marker immediately precedes one canonical inline generated dependency with only optional, path, and version keys.

focused: pnpm vitest run tests/unit/attributed-drift.test.ts tests/integration/init.test.ts tests/integration/remove.test.ts tests/integration/doctor.test.ts

forbidden_changes: Do not broaden supported Cargo forms, store content/paths, edit provider/dialog/process code, dependencies/lockfiles, git, Jira, queue/blocker/release files, or Tinto.
objective: Close the final independent P1 provenance findings for Cargo EOL and created-dependency attribution.
